meta.title: Book a call
meta.description: Book a free 30-minute call with Brisk. Tell us what you want to build and hear back within 24 hours.

hero.lead: Tell us what you want to build. Within 24 hours you'll hear back from the people who will actually make it.

1.title: 30 minutes, free
1.body: We listen and ask questions. You don't have to sell anything, and neither do we.

2.title: A proposal within 48 hours
2.body: A plan with a fixed price per phase. No surprises later on.

3.title: Start when you're ready
3.body: The proposal stays on the table until you are. You set the pace.

form.title: Tell us what you have in mind
form.intro: A handful of fields. Two sentences will do.
form.name: Name
form.messagePlaceholder: What do you want to build, for whom, and by when?
form.note: By sending this you agree to our <link>privacy policy</link>. We never share your details.

success.title: Thanks, we'll email you within 24 hours.
success.body: Your message has arrived. We read everything ourselves and reply with a concrete proposal for a first call.

proof.title: What we've built so far.
proof.lead: No mockups from a deck. Every site below runs for a real client, and the code and the design belong to them.

faq.title: About the first call
faq.lead: Everything worth knowing before you hit send.

1.a: Yes. The first 30-minute call costs nothing and commits you to nothing. Paid work only starts once you approve our proposal.

2.q: Do I need to prepare anything?
2.a: Not necessarily. It helps if you know what you want to achieve and by when. If you have a brief, sketches or examples of sites you like, bring them along. If not, we'll ask the questions.

3.q: Do you work remotely or outside Belgium?
3.a: Yes. We're based in Limburg and do most of our work remotely, for Belgian clients too. A video call works just as well as a coffee. For larger projects we're happy to come by.

4.a: That depends on the scope and on our schedule at the time. After the call you'll receive a proposal within 48 hours with a start date that fits your deadline and our calendar.

closing.note: We read everything ourselves and reply within 24 hours, in English or Dutch.
closing.briefBody: Summarise it in the form and attach the document when you reply to our first email. We read everything, forty-page appendix included.
